what: Six E-AC-3 JOC titles no earlier measurement named, against Dolby's object decoder
why: The object-domain figures came from clips the matrix alignment and the quadrature filter were fitted on.
method: 30 s cut from 10 minutes (tools/ec3_cut.py); dlbac3dec out-ch-config=21 drc-suppress=true drc-mode=custom-0 drop-delay=true; oadec decode --format damf --no-bed-conform; tools/objcmp.py; then --no-dither (dither-check) and a per-subband split of the residual (lowband, residual-bands)
reading: worst object 29.55-49.53 dB, median 40.09-53.64 dB, lag 0, correlation-structure delta <= 0.0021 on every title. On Lion of the Desert and Kar Kardesligi switching our dither off gains 3.0 dB (dither-limited); on Mercy, A Man Called Otto and Damsel 72-96% of the residual lies in subband 0 (0-375 Hz) and the dither switch moves it by 0.0 dB
